title: asystasia chelonoides var. quadrangularis
intro: Asystasia chelonoides var. quadrangularis, commonly known as Asystasia quadrangularis, is a plant species in the Acanthaceae family. It is an herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in West Africa, where it is valued for its health benefits. The plant is used to treat various ailments, including fever, malaria, and respiratory infections, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties. The bioactive constituents of Asystasia quadrangularis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
